findings.title: Google Analytics and Tawk.to load on public pages with no cookie-consent or opt-out gate
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: ConsentProvider reads the stored choice before anything renders and defaults to deny (components/consent/ConsentProvider.tsx:33-58); AnalyticsScripts mounts GA/Tawk only on granted and pushes Consent Mode v2 default-deny + withdrawal (components/consent/AnalyticsScripts.tsx:60-120); the public layout wires both (app/(public)/layout.tsx:58-68); a footer Cookie settings entry point exists.

findings.title: Consent is captured only in the browser and never recorded or enforced server-side; the store quote form collects PII with no consent at all
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: the public lead submit rejects without consent (routes/public.ts:177-181) and records consent_at/consent_version (:217-234); store quotes require + persist consent (routes/store/quotes.ts:94-112); schema columns in supabase/migrations/5302449_consent_recording.sql:17-37; version helper lib/consent.ts; the contact action forwards CONSENT_VERSION.

findings.title: Published retention statement (three years) contradicts the 90-day contact-form PII purge
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: the privacy page states 90-day retention for contact/visitor sessions, store quotes and first-party store analytics and names the providers (app/(public)/privacy/page.tsx:200-213); docs/PRIVACY.md:44-60 carries the platform retention schedule; apps/api/src/__tests__/privacy-retention-doc.test.ts guards the policy figure against the worker constant.

findings.title: Audit-log PII redaction is a shallow key-name filter; person names and job titles are persisted for 365 days
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: redactAuditMetadata recurses through nested objects/arrays and matches name/title/job_title plus substring keys (services/audit.ts:39-83); applied on every write path via logAuditEvent (:100-115).

findings.title: No data-subject access/export/erasure path or DSAR runbook; offboarding never removes profile or auth records
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: audited export GET /users/:id/export (routes/users.ts:394-460) and erasure DELETE /users/:id that scrubs profile PII then deletes the auth user (users.ts:657-724); runbook docs/runbooks/dsar.md covers access/export/erasure incl. public submissions (dsar.md:58-60,127-143); docs/PRIVACY.md:88-104 documents the tooling and the non-user path.

findings.title: Visitor IP addresses are sent to ip-api.com over plaintext HTTP for geolocation
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: the lookup runs only with consent, requires an https:// base URL at runtime (fail-closed), and requests only status/city/regionName/country (routes/public.ts:14-40); GEO_LOOKUP_URL is HTTPS-validated in env.

findings.title: Public store quote/lead PII has no automated retention or purge path and is excluded from the published retention statement
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5, now closed for the source stores: the daily retention task purges store_quotes and store_quote_requests in bounded batches at the resolved 90-day window (tasks/retention.ts:194-205; defaults :27-29; aliases lib/retention-policy.ts:31-44); tests apps/worker/src/__tests__/retention.test.ts:268-285; docs/PRIVACY.md:50-55 and the public policy (app/(public)/privacy/page.tsx:200-213) now state the window and the DSAR runbook (dsar.md:127-143) deletes the two tables. Residual copies in store_proposal_drafts are a new finding (PRIV-P2-009).

findings.title: PRIVACY.md known-gaps section contradicts its own retention schedule (claims store_analytics_events has no purge)
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5, now closed: docs/PRIVACY.md:100-110 no longer claims store_analytics_events has no purge; it lists only store_leads and impersonation_log as un-purged, matching the code (worker retention.ts:190-199 purges store_analytics_events at 90 days).

findings.title: Quote purge and DSAR erasure leave quote PII in store_proposal_drafts.sections
findings.note: NEW at 6b7aa1a5: the new purge deletes store_quotes and store_quote_requests (worker tasks/retention.ts:194-205) but not store_proposal_drafts. The proposal generator copies the submitter's name and free-text notes into sections['Executive summary'] and ['Current situation'] (apps/api/src/lib/proposal-generator.ts:113,119) and the route persists the object (apps/api/src/routes/store/quotes.ts:355-365). store_proposal_drafts has no FK/cascade to the quote request (supabase/migrations/5302115_store_v5_sales_ops.sql:19-28), no retention alias (lib/retention-policy.ts:30-44) and no mention in docs/PRIVACY.md's schedule or the DSAR deletion block (docs/runbooks/dsar.md:127-143). The published 'quote data purged after 90 days' promise is therefore false for the draft copy, and an erasure request leaves it behind. Add store_proposal_drafts to the purge targets and DSAR SQL, or store only non-PII derived text.

findings.title: Direct anon INSERT on store_quotes bypasses the consent gate, validation and rate limits
findings.note: NEW at 6b7aa1a5: migration 5302448:14-18 keeps an anon INSERT policy on store_quotes (organization_id is null) and 5302434:74 grants INSERT to anon; Supabase anon keys are publishable by design (docs/ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLES.md:51 calls it the 'publishable/anon key'). Every legitimate write goes through POST /store/quotes, which requires consent:true, persists consent_at/consent_version and enforces validation/Turnstile/rate limits (apps/api/src/routes/store/quotes.ts:92-112; migration 5302449:17-21). A direct PostgREST insert with the anon key can create name/email/phone/notes rows with consent_at NULL - the schema comment calls NULL 'no consent on record' - with no application controls. Even though this web app does not currently embed the anon key, the DB grant is an unnecessary write surface protected only by key distribution. Revoke the anon grant/policy now that the storefront uses the API, or enforce consent_at/consent_version with a trigger if a direct-write path is truly required.

report: Read-only re-verification at 6b7aa1a5. 12/12 previous PRIV findings are verified fixed, 0 partially fixed, 0 regressed. The two open items closed: public store quote/lead PII now has a bounded 90-day purge with registry-resolved windows (PRIV-P2-008) and PRIVACY.md's known-gaps section now matches the retention schedule (PRIV-P3-004). Two new P2 findings: PRIV-P2-009 (the new purge does not cover store_proposal_drafts, which retains the submitter's name and free-text notes indefinitely and is omitted from the DSAR runbook) and PRIV-P2-010 (anon still holds INSERT on store_quotes, so a direct PostgREST write can create quote PII with consent_at NULL, bypassing the API consent gate). Executed: read consent providers/routes, retention tasks + policy aliases, DSAR runbook, privacy docs and the store quote/proposal paths; checked migration chain 5302105/5302132/5302434/5302448/5302449.
